title: Worker slot reset
summary: Recover the thiscall slot reset at 0x490d30, preserving copied words and untouched storage.
test_description: Compare original and recovered resets over zero, all-one, and patterned slots, including repeated calls, every slot byte, guard bytes, and FS head restoration.
known_limits: The semantic types and purposes of the slot fields remain unresolved.
Only normal calls with valid writable slot storage are tested.
